title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Overview**
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about scaling Cloud services to join our growing SRE team. The SRE team owns the infrastructure, tooling and automation that Jira and Confluence Cloud runs on, and has a deep understanding of how Atlassian products leverage cloud infrastructure to meet customer reliability expectations.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a technical leader who is aware of current industry trends (particularly those related to reliability). You have experience mentoring and growing team members and love to share your knowledge with others. We'd love it if you brought a deep understanding of modern Cloud infrastructure, programming expertise, operational experience and a desire to change the status quo. We're looking for an engineer who can analyse and help improve our services and processes to get us to an even higher level of reliability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. You will report directly to the Senior Engineering Manager.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* 5+ years experience operating high-availability, fault-tolerant, scalable, distributed software in production: building monitoring, tweaking dashboards, defining alerts, writing runbooks, etc.
* 5+ years of hands on experience with public cloud offerings (at least 1 year experience on GCP).
* Familiarity with Unix / Linux operating systems.
* Strong emphasis to debug, improve code, and automate routine tasks.
* Strong backend engineering experience in one or more prominent languages such as Java, Go or Python.
* Excellent communication skills in written and verbal forms, and an ability to communicate complex technical issues to a range of technical and non-technical audiences (management, peers, clients).
* An ability and desire to mentor and coach engineers

**Qualifications**
**It would be great, but not mandatory if you had:**

* Experience in datastores (RDBMS, time-series-database, NoSql, search, analytics).
* Experience in microservice architecture.
* Experience building web-services and clients using REST/GraphQL.
* Expertise in JVM, Garbage Collection, and Performance Tuning.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit

title: TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
description:
**Job Description:**
TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead
  
  

* Location: PAN India
* Number of Positions: 2
* Experience Required: 8–14 Years
* Work Mode: Hybrid

**Job Summary: (P3/P4)**
We are seeking an experienced TechnoFunctional MES Application Lead to own and drive the endtoend delivery and operational support of Körber PASX solutions on Azure AKS, ensuring timely, and highquality MES services within a regulated manufacturing environment. The role combines strong technical depth and functional understanding of MES processes to coordinate crossfunctional teams, manage integrations and dependencies, proactively resolve issues, and ensure validated, compliant, and reliable MES solutions that meet business, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the MES PASX tower (v3.3.x) across programs, ensuring platform stability, scalability and compliance in cloudbased AKS (Azure Kubernetes Services) environments.
* Define and govern MES architecture standards, integration patterns, deployment models and operational best practices for PASX on Azure.
* Ensure alignment of MES tower strategy with manufacturing IT, Digital Manufacturing roadmaps, ISA88/95 standards and enterprise IT governance.
* Act as the single point of accountability for MES PASX delivery, operations, quality and compliance.
* Lead endtoend MES PASX implementations and upgrades, from requirement gathering through configuration, qualification and final delivery.
* Ensure to Coordinate on rollouts and system upgrades for PASX application.
* Own MES Service Delivery Operations, ensuring high availability, performance, and adherence to SLAs.
* Govern 2ndlevel support operations for PASX, Azure, Kubernetes, and MES integrations.
* Lead Incident, Problem, Change and Release Management processes in line with ITIL.
* Proactively identify risks, recurring issues and improvement opportunities to ensure smooth operations.
* Provide technical leadership for PASX deployment and lifecycle management on AKS, including service pack installations and platform upgrades.
* Govern OS, application and platform patching (Windows/Linux) and ensure timely vulnerability remediation.
* Oversee Kubernetes, Linux and databaserelated activities, ensuring performance, resilience and availability of MES environments.
* Collaborate closely with enterprise Infrastructure, Cloud, Security and Network teams.
* Own and govern MES integrations with Level 2, Level 3, and Level 4 systems including SAP ERP, OSI PI, LIMS & Kepware/OPC.
* Ensure robust design, monitoring and support of DCS adapters, services and interfaces.
* Drive troubleshooting for complex crosssystem issues spanning MES, DCS, ERP, and shopfloor automation.
* Establish governance for MES PASX Users & Rights, Control Data & Profiles, Terminals, Printing, and Reporting, Production Units, WMS Master Data, Service & system configurations.
* Ensure data consistency, audit readiness, and alignment with validated system requirements.
* Ensure MES solutions comply with CSV, SDLC, 21 CFR Part 11, cGMP and GAMP requirements.
* Act as the primary interface with vendors such as Körber, Microsoft and system integrators.
* Manage vendor delivery, escalations and roadmap alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, plant teams, QA, infrastructure and enterprise IT leadership.
* Provide technical and functional leadership to MES engineers and support teams.
* Mentor team members on PASX functionality, cloud/K8s concepts, validation and integrations.
* Drive proactive collaboration, knowledge sharing, and operational excellence within the MES tower.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization and performance optimization within MES operations.

title: AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect  ( L11 )
description:
**Role Title :**
AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )
  
  
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
**Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect**
Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery.
  
  
As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges—delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams.
* Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams.
* Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design.
* Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis).
* Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Selenium).
* Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams.
* Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges.
* Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design.
* Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks.
* AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases.
* Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing.
* AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage.
* Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows.
* Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
* Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication.
* System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective.
* Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience designing and building GenAI platforms.
* Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure.
* Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees).

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering.

**Work Timings**
2:00PM to 11:00 PM IST
  
  
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal )
* L09+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L09+ Employees can apply

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
**Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI**
**Role Overview**
Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary
**AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect**
, redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a
**Developer Advocate**
and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.
  
  
This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.
  
  
As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization**

* Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.
* Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.
* Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.
* Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).
* Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.
* Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

**Data & AI Infrastructure**

* Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.
* Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.
* Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.
* Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

**Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture**

* Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.
* Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.
* Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

**GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy**

* You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.
* You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.
* Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

**Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership**

* Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.
* Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.
* Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.
* Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.
* Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

**Who You Are**

* Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.
* Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.
* System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.
* Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.
* Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.
* Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.
* Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.
* Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.
* Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.
* Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.
* Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.
* Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).
* Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).
* Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.
* Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.
* Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

**Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.
* Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.
* Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

**Why Join Us?**

* Impact at scale—we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges.
* Modern technical foundation with room to innovate—leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Hands-on architecture leadership—you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.
* Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts, pushing the limits of what’s possible.
* Competitive compensation and high ownership—your work will define how Jumio scales.

**Jumio Values:**
IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
**:**
Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.
  
  
**About Jumio:**
Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.
  
  
Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.
  
  
**Applicant Data Privacy**
We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com.

description:

title: Systems Analyst
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  
  
**Job Function:**
The role is responsible for the technical delivery, data architecture, and operational support of Channel Data Management (CDM) solutions within a complex enterprise environment, with a strong focus on database design, SQL development, and ETL processes.
  
  
This position defines and delivers high‑value CDM enhancements while ensuring data integrity, system performance, and scalability. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
  
  
This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end-to-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* System Operations, Monitoring & Incident Management
* Provide technical expertise to manage and support complex IT architectures supporting CDM solutions.
* Perform daily CDM system monitoring, including data validation, batch/job execution, and overall system health.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data quality and system issues identified through monitoring activities.
* Manage incidents and changes in alignment with the ITIL framework, including escalation to IT teams and tracking through resolution.
* Maintain, test, and continuously improve business and system operations to ensure stability and performance of 24x7 applications.
* Processes, Technical Solutions, Data & Analytics Enablement

title: Tech S and T-Enterprise Architect - Commercial Sector-Architecture-Senior manager-GDSF04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role: Enterprise Architect – Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST)**
**Experience: 15+ Years**
**Description**
A senior enterprise architecture leadership role responsible for defining technology strategy, driving enterprise-wide modernization and transformation initiatives, and shaping future-state architectures across large, complex organizations.
  
  
The role requires a strong blend of
**enterprise architecture, deep technical architecture credibility, consulting mindset, and stakeholder leadership**
. The Enterprise Architect is expected to engage senior business and technology leaders while providing architectural direction for large-scale, cloud-native and distributed systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead enterprise architecture workstreams for transformation, modernization, and assessment initiatives.
* Design and lead the development of large-scale cloud and custom-built solutions, leveraging modern architecture patterns such as microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native platforms.
* Establish enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, governance frameworks, and modernization roadmaps, including application portfolio rationalization.
* Engage with business stakeholders, architects, delivery teams, and executive governance forums to guide end-to-end solution delivery, architecture decisions, and thought leadership.
* Support presales activities including solution shaping, estimation, proposals, client workshops, and executive presentations.

**Qualifications**
**Educational Background**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Economics, or related fields.

**Enterprise Architecture Expertise**

* 15+ years of IT experience with at least 6+ years in Enterprise Architecture or equivalent senior architecture leadership roles.
* Proven experience defining enterprise target-state architectures, transformation roadmaps, and architecture governance models.
* Strong experience conducting enterprise assessments and application portfolio rationalization initiatives.
* Solid understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and modelling approaches such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, Zachman, or equivalent.

**Technical Depth**

* Strong technical foundation with demonstrated ability to architect and guide delivery of large-scale, complex enterprise systems.
* Cloud Native and Microservices based solutions

+ Expertise in cloud-native architectures, microservices, API-led integration, event-driven systems, and distributed architectures.
+ Experience designing systems for scalability, resilience, security, high availability, and performance.
+ Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, data platforms, containers, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, and observability.
+ Experience working across AWS, Azure, GCP, or hybrid/multi-cloud environments.
+ Provide full stack architecture leadership, designing solutions across front end, back end, integration, data, and cloud layers, including modern web-based front end technologies such as React or Angular.

* Architecture experience with AI based solutions

+ Architecture-level understanding of AI/ML, Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
+ Ability to define high-level GenAI solution architectures involving enterprise knowledge bases, document search, summarization, workflow automation, and conversational interfaces.
+ Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI, model risk, data privacy, security, guardrails, human oversight, and regulatory considerations.

**Leadership & Consulting Skills**

* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead architecture teams, and steer complex transformation programs.
* Strong communication, consulting, and presentation skills, including experience delivering thought leadership.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Architecture and cloud certifications such as AWS/Azure/GCP certifications or similar.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Overview**
Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization.
  
  
You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities.
  
  
Working at Atlassian
  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.
  
  
**As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will**

* Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
* Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
* Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
* Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
* Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
* You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
* You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost.
* Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
* Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
* Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
* Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
* A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
* Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
* Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
* Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
* Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
* Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
* Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
* Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

Benefits & Perks
  
  
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Academy AF A ContentAggregator
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior content aggregation specialist within the Academy AF A function designing and operating robust hybrid solutions that unify learning data and digital assets from diverse enterprise and external sources. Apply expertise in Net SQL Python and modern generative AI platforms including Gemini AI Claude and Open AI to curate classify and expose high quality training content. Deliver reliable day shift outcomes that elevate organizational capability and societal impact through ac
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and maintain scalable content aggregation workflows that collect normalize and classify learning materials from internal repositories and approved external sources to ensure a unified and reliable Academy catalog.
* Develop and optimize Net based services and APIs that securely expose aggregated content to front end applications and downstream platforms while maintaining high performance and reliability.
* Create robust Python scripts and automation routines to process metadata perform text transformation and orchestrate batch ingestion jobs that keep the content library current and comprehensive.
* Use SQL to design efficient data models queries and procedures that support fast retrieval advanced filtering and detailed reporting across the consolidated learning content store.
* Apply Gemini AI to generate insightful summaries recommend relevant learning paths and enrich metadata so that employees can quickly discover material that supports their growth and productivity.
* Apply Claude capabilities to analyze long form learning content extract key concepts and improve instructional clarity enhancing the overall quality and accessibility of Academy assets.
* Apply Open AI models to enable personalized content suggestions conversational search and adaptive learning experiences that improve engagement and skill acquisition for diverse learners.
* Collaborate closely with instructional designers and subject matter experts to validate aggregated content refine taxonomies and ensure alignment with enterprise learning objectives and compliance standards.
* Implement robust data quality checks observability metrics and issue resolution routines that minimize broken links duplicate records and outdated material across hybrid content pipelines.
* Document aggregation processes data flows and integration patterns in clear operational guides that enable consistent day shift support and smooth handoffs among distributed team members.
* Coordinate with platform engineers and security specialists to ensure that all integrations data movements and AI workloads comply with governance requirements and protect sensitive information.
* Monitor usage analytics feedback signals and content performance indicators to propose targeted improvements that enhance learning outcomes and amplify the impact of Academy programs on society.
* Drive continuous refinement of hybrid work practices using collaboration tools and structured communication methods so that onsite and remote team members deliver cohesive and predictable content services.

**Qualifications**

* Bring seven to eleven years of experience working with enterprise grade content or data platforms demonstrating accountability for end to end aggregation curation and delivery outcomes in complex environments.
* Show advanced proficiency in Net application development with emphasis on building secure and modular services that integrate seamlessly with databases APIs and generative AI platforms.
* Demonstrate strong SQL skills in designing normalized schemas writing optimized queries and tuning data workloads to support analytics reporting and rapid content discovery.
* Exhibit deep Python expertise in building automation frameworks data processing utilities and integration scripts that manage large volumes of structured and unstructured learning materials.
* Provide hands on experience working with Gemini AI Claude and Open AI to design practical solutions for summarization classification recommendation and conversational access to learning content.
* Offer a track record of operating effectively in hybrid work models by using digital collaboration tools documenting workflows and maintaining consistent communication during standard day shifts.
* Prefer prior exposure to corporate learning ecosystems or digital education platforms where content aggregation curation standards and learner centric experiences were central responsibilities.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Microsoft Certified Net Developer and Microsoft Certified Azure Data Engineer or equivalent cloud data qualification relevant to SQL and Python.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description: Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.Life as a Sprinter -Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together; they're built by pulling in the same direction.We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.The mission -Autonomy is the easy half. Making it defensible is the hard half.What the platform produces is not a suggestion that a customer can take or leave. It's used as fact by auditors and enterprise buyers whose decisions depend on us being right. Wrong in one direction, a customer loses a certification because of us. Wrong in the other, we bury them in noise until they stop reading anything we send.Your mission is to make a defensible half, making agent judgment something a third party will accept.Where you'll leave your mark?Agents whose output nobody re-checks. You'll see how we prove an agent is trustworthy: evaluation harnesses that gate releases rather than run quarterly, golden sets built with real compliance experts, regression suites assembled from production traces, and drift detection that fires before a customer notices. Not a set of scripts — a platform every other team builds on. You'll know it works when a compliance lead stops reviewing a category of output, and nothing breaks.A system that can prove what it said, and admit when it didn't know. Compliance is a claim about the past, which means state as of a date has to be held separately from when we learned it, and every artefact has to carry unbroken provenance from the source system to the audit package. The other half of the problem is honesty under failure. At several hundred connectors, partial failures are normal, and a connector returning nothing because Okta is down must never look like a control genuinely failing. Passing, failing and unknown are three different states, and that distinction has to survive all the way to the interface.Beyond those two, there are surfaces you'll work across without owning alone: tenant isolation and enterprise identity as we move upmarket, the inference economics that decide whether continuous monitoring is viable at scale, and how we model 200 frameworks so the next one is cheap. And since every engineer here will be building with agents within a year, we'll expect the practice to be better across the org because you joined.The kind of builder we're looking for -Someone who has built something that changed the shape of the work. Not a prototype — a system where an LLM took autonomous, multi-step action against real data and real users, and displaced something people used to do by hand. We'll want to hear what it replaced, what it cost, what its failure rate was, and how you measured it. An engineer who treats the model as an untrusted subsystem. Constrained outputs, independent verification, thresholds that escalate rather than guess, a clear line between what the model decides and what it only proposes. We're more interested in how your system detected and contained a bad output than in how it tried to prevent one. Depth in at least two of these, with room to pick up the rest here: production LLM and agent systems; temporal and provenance data modeling; high-fan-out integration reliability; multi-tenant and enterprise identity; inference cost engineering; domain modeling for messy regulatory rules. 10+ years building software, at least two of them at Staff scope — setting technical direction that engineers outside your reporting line followed. Range. Some quarters this role is an architect setting direction, some quarters it's the person taking on the problem nobody has cracked, some quarters it's carrying a team through a hard delivery. The people who do well here read what the company needs and adapt. Willingness to challenge how we build, and to hold the line when it counts. We're hiring partly for disagreement — on our architecture, our agent design, our standards. That includes telling go-to-market what we can't yet defend, and offering a path rather than a refusal. Influence without authority. Nobody on this team reports to you. Your leverage is clarity, credibility and the quality of your reasoning across Engineering, Product, Security and CX — and since we're remote-first, most of that happens in writing. How we care for our Sprinters?Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beachCo-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowanceWe care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skillsWe count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need toYour Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salaryWorkspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for youInclusion & Diversity -At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, performance, and operational excellence of mission-critical fintech platforms hosted across AWS, Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF/Tanzu), and Hybrid On-Premise environments. * Cloud Migration & Modernization: Lead and contribute to migration of workloads from on-premise / PCF estates to AWS-native and containerized (Kubernetes/Docker) platforms, ensuring resilience and zero-business-impact cutovers.
* Observability: Build and enhance the observability stack across Prometheus, New Relic, Grafana, Splunk, CloudWatch and create actionable dashboards, golden signals, and intelligent alerting that reduce noise and accelerate triage.
* Incident & Change Management: Own major incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews; uphold ITIL-aligned change, problem, and release management disciplines.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in SRE, CloudOps, DevOps, or Production Engineering roles, preferably within the Fintech / Banking / Financial Services domain with overall 7+ years of industry experience.
* Minimum 5+ years of expertise across Cloud Platforms: AWS (EC2, EKS, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, VPC), PCF / Tanzu, and Hybrid On-Premise environments.
* Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes and Docker at production scale.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (modules, state management, governance).
* CI/CD Tooling: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD (GitOps).
* Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, and the ELK stack.
* Databases: Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra (operations and performance).
* Practical knowledge of ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
* Proven experience driving SLO/SLI frameworks, error budgets, and reliability KPIs in a regulated enterprise.
* Demonstrated success in cloud migration, modernization, and FinOps-led cost optimization programs.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills with the ability to engage technology and business leadership.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Hands-on experience in AWS/PCF/Hybrid environments with strong understanding of production support and cloud operations.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform (or equivalent IaC) for deployment and automation.
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins/GitHub Actions/ArgoCD) and observability platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, or ELK).
* Good incident/change management practices (ITIL-aligned), basic scripting (Shell/Python), and strong cross-team communication skills.

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* AWS Certification (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps Administrator / DevOps Engineer) will be considered an added advantage.

EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. **The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.

* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. title: Senior DevOps Engineer_Req 117
description:
**Senior DevOps Engineer — Platform Deployment & Multi-Cloud Infrastructure**
Location: [Remote / Hybrid — specify]
  
  
Team: Platform Engineering / Innovation
  
  
Employment type: Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve the deployment of our AI-powered application modernization platform (NEXUS) into client production environments. This role is a unique hybrid of Platform Engineering and Technical Advisory. You will not only design the underlying multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) but also partner directly with client IT groups to establish SysOps frameworks. You will leverage our AI-driven automation tools to provision infrastructure, integrate AIOps for anomaly detection and remediation, and ensure clients receive seamless product updates via our Helm-based delivery pipeline.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role that requires a "product mindset"—you are designing for scale, security, and long-term operational sustainability in client environments.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Client Collaboration & SysOps Partnership
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical partner to client IT groups, guiding them on best practices for operating bespoke NEXUS implementations.
* Work with client-aligned delivery teams to manage the lifecycle of the platform, ensuring timely and reliable product updates via Helm charts.
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to tailor infrastructure and operational workflows, ensuring NEXUS integrates seamlessly with their existing enterprise monitoring and ticketing systems.

AI-Driven Automation & AIOps Integration
  
  

* Build & Leverage AI for Provisioning: Architect and implement AI-assisted workflows to automate the provisioning and configuration of infrastructure across multi-cloud environments.
* AIOps Implementation: Integrate and adopt 3Pillar’s AIOps platform into client ecosystems to enable proactive, automated anomaly detection and incident remediation.
* Knowledge Base Evolution: Maintain and refine the AIOps knowledge base, training agents to perform accurate root-cause analysis (RCA) and automate recurring issue resolution. 1

Platform & Multi-Cloud Development
  
  

* Evolve our Helm-based platform layer and Terraform module libraries to support standardized, secure deployment patterns across AWS, Azure, and GCP. 1 2
* Design for "Delegation": Move our automation from simple execution to self-adapting workflows that handle ambiguity and get smarter over time. 3
* Ensure all infrastructure-as-code and automated remediation scripts meet rigorous enterprise security and compliance standards, including PII access logging and least-privilege IAM.

**Our technology stack**
You should be comfortable working with most of the following (or able to ramp quickly):
  
  
Area
  
  
Technologies
  
  
IaC
  
  
Terraform (>= 1.5), remote state (S3 + DynamoDB), module versioning via Git tags
  
  
Cloud
  
  
AWS (primary for client deployments): EKS, VPC, NLB, EFS, ECR, Route 53, KMS, IAM/IRSA
  
  

* Azure: AKS, Key Vault, ACR, VNet
* GCP: GKE, Artifact Registry

Kubernetes
  
  
Production cluster operations, storage classes, ingress, HPA, troubleshooting CrashLoop / init failures
  
  
Packaging
  
  
Helm (umbrella charts, atomic releases), feature-flag-driven deployments
  
  
Platform services
  
  
HashiCorp Vault, Keycloak, OAuth2 Proxy, cert-manager, Zalando Postgres Operator, Neo4j, Redis Operator, Strimzi Kafka, Prometheus/Grafana/Loki, Apache Airflow, MinIO
  
  
Application platform
  
  
Python/FastAPI backend, React frontend, MCP server, background workers, retrieval/RAG services; container images on a private registry (e.g. GHCR)
  
  
CI/CD & GitOps
  
  
GitHub Actions, Flux (internal environments), image signing (Cosign)
  
  
Observability & ops
  
  
kubectl, helm, structured logging (Loki), metrics/alerts, operational runbooks
  
  
Security
  
  
TLS (Let's Encrypt DNS-01), secrets via Vault/VSO, SSO/OIDC, VPN / CIDR-based ingress controls
  
  
**Required Experience**

* Client-Facing Advisory & Enablement: Proven experience in a technical advisory or client-facing engineering role. You are comfortable partnering with client IT teams, guiding them through technical adoption, and translating complex platform requirements into operational success.
* DevOps & Infrastructure Expertise: 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering. You possess production-grade Terraform experience—architecting modular, multi-cloud IaC frameworks that enable consistent, repeatable deployments across different environments.
* AIOps & Observability: Hands-on experience integrating or managing AIOps platforms or automated observability stacks. You understand the lifecycle of incident response, anomaly detection, and automated remediation.
* AI-Driven Automation: Demonstrated experience building automation workflows. You don’t just write scripts; you build systems that reduce manual operational toil and empower users through self-service provisioning and automated configuration.
* Platform Engineering at Scale: Deep expertise in Kubernetes and Helm. You have a track record of deploying and operating complex, multi-service platforms and managing their lifecycle (chart development, values layering, atomic releases).
* Foundational Cloud Operations: Proven AWS expertise (EKS, networking, IAM/IRSA) with a strong aptitude for multi-cloud environments (Azure/GCP).
* Identity & Security: Solid experience with secrets management (HashiCorp Vault or similar) and identity/SSO integration (Keycloak/OIDC).
* Communication & Mentorship: Excellent written and verbal communication. You are able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and mentor teams on best practices.

**Strongly Preferred / Nice To Have**

* Consultative Experience: Prior work as a Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Implementation Engineer in a SaaS or Managed Services environment.
* AI/LLM Infrastructure: Experience managing infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, including GPU node pools, vector databases (e.g., Neo4j), or RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
* GitOps & Lifecycle: Hands-on experience with GitOps methodologies (Flux, Argo CD) for managing continuous deployment at scale.
* Enterprise Compliance: Experience operating within regulated or enterprise environments (PII logging, audit trails, network isolation, SOC2/compliance-heavy workflows).
* Kafka & Distributed Systems: Experience with event streaming platforms (e.g., Strimzi/Kafka) or specialized operators for stateful services.

**What success looks like in your first 6–12 months**

* Successful enablement of client IT teams to independently manage and operate the NEXUS platform.
* Quantifiable reduction in manual operational toil for clients through the successful adoption of AIOps-driven anomaly detection and automated remediation.
* Seamless, low-friction delivery of platform updates via automated Helm-based pipelines.
* Deployment of robust, AI-provisioned infrastructure stacks that adapt to client-specific demands while maintaining security and compliance.

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. **Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Senior level)**
**Description**
 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a modern way of delivering IT Solutions by imbibing Software engineering principles in Service Delivery to reduce IT Risk to business, improve business resilience, attain predictability \& reliability, optimize cost of IT Infra and Ops
   

  

 A Site Reliability Engineer typically has deep software engineering experience encompassing design, build, deploy and manage / maintain an IT solution ensuring resilience, reliability, and performance.
   

  

 An SRE is a bridge between development and operations by applying a software engineering mindset to the development, deployment, and maintenance of applications to maximize system reliability \& automation, while improving efficiencies by optimizing resources
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Defining SLA/SLO/SLI for a product / service
* Engineering in resilient design and implementation practices into solutions as they go through the product life cycle
* Engineering out manual effort (Toil) through the development of automated processes and services (e.g., Automated Management of Systems, CI/CD improvements)
* Developing Observability Solutions to track, report, and measure SLA adherence
* Help Optimize Cost of IT Infra \& Operations \- FinOps
* Critical Situation management
* SOP / Runbook automation, Toil reduction
* Data Analytics \& System trend analysis


**Typical Skills And Background**
* 7\+ years of experience in software product engineering principles, processes and systems
* Hands\-on experience in Java / J2EE, one of web server (Apache Tomcat or IBM HTTP Server), one of the application servers (Tomcat/WebSphere), and any major RDBMS like Oracle
* Hands\-on experience in at least one CI\-CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins) and IaC tools (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible etc.)
* Experience in at least one cloud technology (AWS/Azure/GCP etc. and Docker, Pivotal, Kubernetes, OpenShift etc.) and its reliability tools (Azure AppInsight, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor etc.)
* Experience in Linux (RHEL) operating system performance monitoring parameters and their interpretation, commands used for monitoring
* Experience in Observability \- APM tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics etc.), metrics / log consolidation (Splunk) and ELK Stack
* Defining NFRs and SLA/SLO/SLI agreement for a product / platform / services
* Knowledge on queuing models used, thread pools, request servicing processes etc.
* Knowledge in Web Services, SOA, ESB (DataPower), RESTFul
* Knowledge of application design patterns, J2EE application architectures, Microservices, Spring boot \& Cloud native architectures
* Proficiency in Java runtimes, Core Java, Garbage collection, JVM parameters tuning
* Experience in performance tuning on Application Servers (Tomcat/WAS)
* Experience in trouble shooting Performance / Scalability / Availability issues
* Experience in Thread dump, heap dump generation \& analysis
* Knowledge on Query tuning and database designs \& models
* Knowledge at least one automation scripting language like Python
* Mastery in collaborative software development using Git, Jira, Confluence etc.
* AI/ML \& Data Analytics knowledge and experience is a desirable
